name: Life Cycle Assessment for Textiles
description: Introduction to LCA: scope, boundaries, methodology (goal and scope, inventory analysis, impact assessment, interpretation), ISO standards, alignment with SDGs; environmental footprint analysis of textile raw materials: cotton, silk, wool; yarn and fabric production: energy consumption and emissions; chemical processing and garment manufacturing: dyeing impacts, effluent treatment, energy use, waste disposal; product use and end-of-life impacts: washing, recycling, circular economy practices; LCA tools and software; LCA for handloom products; case studies of specific products (for example, cotton T-shirts, denim jeans) and eco-labeling practices.
